name: logicgate-sdet-live-farm
description: LogicGate SDET live coding exercise - Angular app + Express/TS mock server, run together.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix mock-server && npm install --prefix angular-app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n mock-server,angular -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix mock-server" "npm start --prefix angular-app"
